newsitem.title: USA: Medic Computer, National Data in pact.
newsitem.headline: Medic Computer, National Data in pact.

text.p: National Data Corp NDC.N and Medic Computer Systems said on Monday that they had formed a partnership to extend NDC's health information network to Medic's customer base of more than 10,000 physician practices.
Terms of the agreement were not disclosed.
"NDC's services will ensure patients are eligible for insurance benefits, and provide more accurate and timely billing information," said Medic president Alan Winchester
Medic's physician customer base currently obtains insurance authorizations by telephone.
